title: Munich DevHub — travel & vendor admin scratchpad
content:
Quick brain dump and admin checklist for the Munich DevHub (July pop-up) — for my own travel + vendor admin. Status: rough, will hand off final vendor invoices to finance.

Trip highlights / dates
- Onsite window: 2025-07-14 (arrive evening) to 2025-07-18 (depart AM).
- Meetups: July 15 all-day workshop; July 16 demo night + light snacks; July 17 half-day wrap + vendor teardown.

Travel notes (personal)
- Flights: LH1239 (SFO->MUC) 07/14 16:20-11:05+1, return LH1240 07/18 13:45-16:00.
- Hotel: NH Collection München (group rate; block: REDWOOD_MUC). Check-out 07/18 by 11:00.
- Local transport: DB to Marienplatz then U-Bahn U3 to station. Taxi/GoCar only for late arrivals.

Expense reminders for receipts
- Capture photo of every receipt, name file: YYYYMMDD_vendor_amount_currency (e.g., 20250715-bahnhof-5.80-EUR).
- For meals: itemize per-person if paying for group; note attendee names in receipt comment.
- Per-diem: use company per-diem table (see Confluence link). For Germany use actual receipts; reimbursements require card vs cash note.
- Currency conversion: use date-of-expense rate via Oanda (attach screenshot) or default to bank rate in expense system.
- VAT / EU invoicing: if vendor provides VAT number, request full invoice (company name: Redwood Inference Inc. — include PO if provided). For refunds: finance needs net and VAT line separated.

Vendor contacts / quick dial
- AV & staging: SoundHaus Munich — Markus Weber — +49 89 1234 5678 — markus@soundhaus.de. Note: ask for backline DI boxes and 2x lapel mics.
- Caterer (demo night snacks): Brot & Butter Catering — contact: Anna Meier — anna@brotundbutter.de — prefers 72h lead time. Vegetarian/gluten-free options confirmed.
- Badge printing: FastTags GmbH — support@fasttags.de — mention event code RED-MUC-25 for on-site badge printing.
- Local florist (stage greenery): BlumenKraft — +49 89 9876 5432 — Thomas Kurz.
- Hotel contact for group rate: reservations@nhcollection-muc.de — Attn: Group Sales - block REDWOOD_MUC.

Invoice / PO notes (to vendor)
- If vendor needs PO: PO-ENG-2025-078. Email invoices to ap@redwood.ai and cc travel@redwood.ai. Finance requires invoice PDF + W-9 (US vendors) or VAT registration docs (EU vendors).
- Payment terms: Net30 unless otherwise negotiated. Escalate odd terms to finance (Grace Liu).

On-site checklist (things to pack / arrange)
- Bring HDMI dongles (USB-C, miniDP), 1x spare Macbook charger, power strips with EU plugs.
- Printed attendee list (final headcount by 07/10). Bring sticky name badges for last-minute signups.
- Bring 1 printed stack of receipts policies and expense form QR code (link to Confluence). Put in welcome kit folder.
- Photo release forms for demo participants (digital copy on tablet and paper backup).

Day-of contact plan
- Local lead: Marco Jansen — +49 151 2345 6789 — meet at venue 07/15 08:00.
- Ops on call: Riya Singh (US hours overlap) — slack:@riya — fallback: Liu Chen.

Open items / TODOs (owner)
- Confirm final AV rider and mic counts with Markus (Aisha) — due 2025-06-20.
- Finalize catering headcount and dietary restrictions (Marco) — due 2025-07-08.
- Get vendor PO created and shared with caterer/AV (Finance/Grace) — watch JIRA TRAVEL-4123.
- Confirm badge printing turnaround + backfill plan if printer delayed (Liu) — due 2025-07-05.
- Verify whether hotel can provide early check-in (Aisha) — pending.

Notes to self (messy)
- Remember to label receipts immediately — avoid backlog.
- Keep one physical envelope with cash petty for day-of emergencies (max 200 EUR) and log transactions.
- If we exceed budget for demo night food, mark as "manager approval required" in expense note and flag in Jira.

Post-event ops
- Collect final vendor invoices by 07/22 and push to AP folder: /finance/invoices/MUC-2025 (Confluence reference).
- Survey attendees via short Typeform; include question about travel reimbursements timeframe.
- Add a short ‘lessons learned’ doc in Confluence and link back to this scratchpad.

Random links and refs
- Confluence event brief: CONFLUENCE:DEVHUB-MUC-2025
- JIRA travel ticket: TRAVEL-4123
- Slack channel: #munich-dev-hub

Notes for expense entry format (Expense system)
- Expense title: MUC Demo Night - <vendor> - <date>
- Attach: invoice/receipt + bank card statement if vendor charged the company card.
- For multi-person meals: add attendee list in the comment field; total meal cost split is handled by finance.

Questions to resolve later
- Can we use the NH hotel kitchen for final morning coffee instead of external caterer (cost tradeoff)? (Aisha)
- Do we need an import declaration for promo swag crossing EU borders? (Marco to check with customs broker)

End of scratchpad — will tidy after final vendor confirmations.
